title: POAG and IOP GWAS colocalization summary per locus
bodyHtml: The table below lists the results of colocalizing expression quantitative trait loci (eQTLs) and splicing quantitative trait loci (sQTLs) from GTEx and retina eQTLs (EyeGEx; Ratnapriya, Sosina, Starostik et al., 2019) with GWAS loci associated with primary open-angle glaucoma (POAG; Gharahkhani et al., 2021) or intraocular pressure (IOP; Khawaja et al., 2018), using the eCAVIAR (Hormozdiari et al., 2016) and fastENLOC (Wen et al., 2017) methods, as well as the union and intersection of those results. Only the significant colocalizations are shown (CLPP>0.01 and/or RCP>0.1). Chromosome positions are in genome build 38. The table was taken from Supplementary Data 13 in Taken from Figure 1 in Hamel et al., 2024.
